name: Percival
summary: The core orbital workhorse: a reusable glide-return orbiter delivering 10 t to LEO at roughly $297/kg, then gliding home for reuse.
description: EX-3 Percival is the core orbital workhorse: a reusable, glide-return orbiter delivering 10,000 kg to low Earth orbit and landing for reuse. It rides the TX-04 Pauldron off the pad, delivers its payload, deorbits, re-enters belly-first behind non-ablative armour, and glides to a runway or soft-pad. Headline result: 10 t to LEO at roughly $3.0M per mission ($297/kg at 1,000-flight reuse life).

sections.heading: Mission
sections.body: Deliver 10 t to LEO, deploy payload or a module, loiter if needed on ZBO-held methalox, deorbit, re-enter belly-first, and glide home for reuse. The cheapest crewed-capable payload vehicle in the fleet.

sections.heading: Fleet role
sections.body: The orbital workhorse and the vehicle that wins early contracts and investor reputation. EX-3 feeds the orbital depot; EX-4 (its re-fitted frame) ferries crew to lunar orbit.

changelog.what: v6.6: 3-engine cluster + IDSS dock + airlock/shelter + wet-strake resolved

decisions.why: Runway/soft-pad glide with non-ablative armour for high reuse life and low cost/kg.

openItems: Cryo/GOX rotary seal for the rotating-nozzle TVC.
